title: Hollenbeck syndrome genetics
text: Hollenbeck syndrome is a rare neurodevelopmental disorder. Affected families carry loss-of-function variants in the gene KRN7, which was identified by linkage analysis in 14 pedigrees.

title: KRN7 protein function
text: KRN7 encodes kernase-7, a serine kinase that regulates the cell cycle by phosphorylating the transcription factor CDX2 in neural progenitors. Reduced kernase-7 activity delays neuronal differentiation in cultured cells.

title: Valtrexin inhibits kernase-7
text: In biochemical assays, the small molecule valtrexin inhibited kernase-7 with an IC50 of 12 nM. Valtrexin showed selectivity over 90 other kinases.

title: Tavorin in episodic migraine
text: In a randomized trial, tavorin reduced monthly migraine days by 2.1 days compared with placebo. Nausea was the most common adverse event.

title: Lorvastatin and LDL cholesterol
text: Lorvastatin lowered LDL cholesterol by 38% over 12 weeks in adults with hypercholesterolemia. Muscle symptoms were reported in 4% of participants.

title: Pellin in sepsis models
text: Pellin, an inhibitor of the enzyme PLX2, improved survival in a mouse model of sepsis. Human efficacy has not been tested.

title: Gene NRF9 and oxidative stress
text: The transcription factor NRF9 upregulates antioxidant genes under oxidative stress. NRF9 knockout cells showed increased reactive oxygen species.

title: Beta-minerol randomized trial
text: Daily supplementation with beta-minerol did not significantly reduce fracture risk in a randomized trial of 2,000 adults followed for three years.

title: Beta-minerol cohort study
text: In a cohort study of postmenopausal women, beta-minerol supplementation was associated with a significantly lower fracture risk. Residual confounding cannot be excluded.

title: Zelmab in plaque psoriasis
text: Zelmab, a monoclonal antibody against interleukin-44, cleared plaque psoriasis in 62% of patients at week 16. Injection-site reactions were mild.

title: Mitochondrial dynamics review
text: Mitochondrial fission and fusion balance affects cellular energy metabolism. Dysregulated dynamics are reported in several neurodegenerative conditions.
